tweets.text:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
tweets.summary_en: HackerTube filters 43 million Hacker News comments into 6,454 repeatedly recommended videos, offering login-free discovery and representative thumbnails. Built and deployed largely through Claude in about two hours, it illustrates how AI agents can compress ambitious side projects from weeks into hours.

Upcoming episodes of Behind the Craft:

tweets.text:
Increasingly this will be the new job description for a lot of roles, not just coding. We’re clearly moving from a world where agents help us do our work incrementally better or faster, to us helping agents do their work.

This turns everyone in one of these positions to that of a manager of a team of agents, instead of an individual contributor with just some added leverage from AI. The biggest areas of impact will be information-heavy jobs, like coding, cybersecurity, legal work, biotech, engineering, and many other fields. 

And as a result, in these jobs your leverage will begin to be decoupled from the normal ratio of hours spent working to output generated. For essentially the history of knowledge work the main variable you had to play with was hours of work done (assuming fixed level talent/coordination/strategy). 

Now we’ve separated these variables because agents can parallelize work for us, to in theory execute as much as we need to pull off whatever goal we’re trying to accomplish. The people and organizations that discover this sooner, and orient their operations around it, will see compounding gains in their workflows.
tweets.summary_en: Information-heavy roles are shifting from individuals assisted by AI toward humans managing teams of agents. Parallel agent work could decouple output from human hours, giving people and organizations that reorganize early compounding productivity gains.

slang_glossary.definition_zh: A/B 测试；比较两个版本的表现，以判断哪个效果更好。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Optimized to an extreme degree, often for a narrow metric such as clicks.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 经过极度优化的，常指围绕点击量等单一指标反复打磨。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A credential used to identify or authorize an application accessing an API.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: API 密钥；用于识别或授权应用调用接口的凭证。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An informal name for a virtual private server used to run applications.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 对虚拟专用服务器的口语称呼，可用于运行应用和托管网站。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Started a computer, server, or system.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 启动了计算机、服务器或系统。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Here, an IP address identifying a server on a network.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 此处指 IP 地址，即服务器在网络上的地址。

slang_glossary.definition_en: To reduce a system's security weaknesses and exposure to attack.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 安全加固；减少系统漏洞和可被攻击的入口。

slang_glossary.definition_en: To put software into an environment where it can run and serve users.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 部署；将软件放到能够运行并为用户提供服务的环境中。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Used playfully here to mean completed with just a few AI prompts or interactions; technically, few-shot prompting supplies a few examples.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 此处戏称只需几次 AI 提示或交互就完成；技术上的少样本提示则指提供少量示例。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A figurative expression suggesting something can be done easily or quickly.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 比喻做起来轻松或迅速，类似「吃顿早饭的工夫就搞定」。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Secured or accumulated for later use; the exact meaning of the sample's progress notation is unclear.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 已攒下、已存好或已确保获得；样本中进度标记的具体含义不明确。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An open, sincere conversation about personal feelings or concerns.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 坦诚交心的谈话，通常涉及个人感受或忧虑。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A dismissive term for low-quality, generic, or carelessly produced AI-generated content.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 对低质量、千篇一律或粗制滥造的 AI 生成内容的贬称。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A guided, step-by-step demonstration of a process or example.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 逐步讲解或操作演示。
